items.name: wait-header-inventory
items.staticTrace: The second foreign header enters the recognized marker inventory. The intact count gate refuses before selecting a header. Omitting only that gate selects the first valid header and accepts the stream.

items.name: wait-whole-header
items.staticTrace: The trailing literal remains on the single recognized header. Fullmatch refuses. The selected re.match relaxation accepts the valid prefix without introducing a None/index error.

items.name: wait-result
items.staticTrace: The recognized result line says failure. The entire result-list equality refuses. Removing it leaves a valid header and main line.

items.name: wait-main

items.name: wait-zero-suffix
items.staticTrace: The direct grammar call contains exactly32 zero hex digits. Removing its zero check accepts at this function boundary. Whole-parent ACK validation remains an overlapping zero-INV boundary and is not bypassed or counted here.

items.name: wait-ack-join
items.staticTrace: The wait suffix is well-formed and nonzero but differs from the valid independent raw ACK. Both grammar and ACK remain valid. Omitting only their join allows correlation.

items.name: ack-recorded-properties
items.staticTrace: Recorded MemoryMax drifts; raw properties, entry resources and raw custody remain valid. Raw binding passes, then recorded-properties equality refuses. No later guard compares this dictionary independently.

items.name: ack-raw-entry
items.staticTrace: Raw and recorded MainPID co-change together. The independent entry PID stays fixed. Raw-binding equality refuses. After its removal the recorded dictionary and raw hashes agree.

items.name: ack-custody

items.name: entry-resources
items.staticTrace: The entry-only tasksMax changes to63. Raw and recorded manager properties remain exact. The dedicated full resource comparison refuses; other raw property gates cannot establish this separate entry record.

items.name: request-intent
items.staticTrace: Request004 intent timeout changes to44, while terminal timeout and fixed spec remain45. Removing intent equality exposes acceptance; the unchanged terminal-timeout gate still sees its valid value.

items.name: request-input
items.staticTrace: Request004 input bytes append a literal drift marker while its source pin and intent hash remain fixed. The exact source-byte comparison refuses. Removing it does not silently change the source descriptor.

items.name: request-helper-pid
items.staticTrace: Request002 helper PID is integer zero. Its fieldset and ack string remain exact, and zero differs from all three positive actors. Removing the positive guard therefore exposes acceptance.

items.name: manager-clean-terminal
items.staticTrace: A coherent collected/stored terminal retains code0 but records cleanup and UNKNOWN classification. The whole logical clean-status equality refuses. The mutant removes that equality as one shared logical boundary, not one scalar check.

items.name: terminal-record-durability
items.staticTrace: The process terminal file exists, but the returned and stored collection result explicitly says terminalRecorded=false with an error descriptor. Omitting the combined durability gate permits the remaining exact file joins. This is not proof of actual durability.

items.name: ready-prefix
items.staticTrace: Only saved ready.stdout appends a drift marker. Actual raw stdout and saved JSON remain valid. Removing the raw-prefix equality exposes acceptance before unchanged identity and dependent-input guards.

items.name: dependent-source
items.staticTrace: Request004 dependent bytes and their own intent hash co-change. The accepted external source and descriptor stay fixed. Removing only exact source-byte equality allows the otherwise coherent dependent intent.

items.name: dependent-backend
items.staticTrace: Only the recorded dependent backendPID changes. Actual readiness, dependent bytes and hash stay valid. The combined dependent-intent comparison refuses. No same-backend claim follows from this model.

items.name: retained-map
items.staticTrace: All three supplied maps co-change their census value, retain383 labels and preserve valid inventory. Stored outputs and request hashes co-seal. Removing the retained-oracle loop exposes the fresh-current-map substitution; unchanged current-inventory checks cannot repair it.

items.name: output-custody
items.staticTrace: Only stored catalogue.json unknown-function identity metadata changes. Raw catalogue stdout remains valid. The combined parsed-object/canonical-byte output guard refuses. Removing it exposes the divergent stored output.

items.name: current-inventory
items.staticTrace: Only the after inventory has a new unique positive OID for an existing label. Each individual inventory still passes its count/type/kind/name gates. The full before-versus-after equality is the intended refusal.

items.name: complete-exact
items.staticTrace: Only fixtureLaunchable changes to true. The shared complete equality refuses. Removing it exposes this false-flag violation while the independent unresolved list checks still pass.

items.name: unknown-definition
items.staticTrace: One unreviewed function carries the nonsecret INERT_UNKNOWN_LABEL value instead of null. Other fields and its complete unresolvedOID list remain coherent. Removing no-wire equality exposes acceptance.

items.name: collector-primary
items.staticTrace: A supplied real-pipe read raises OSError, then output fsync also raises. The intact collector retains the read primary and separate fsync cleanup. Removing primary assignment violates the direct original-primary assertion.

items.name: collector-primary-overwrite
items.staticTrace: The same supplied failures occur. Replacing cleanup append with primary assignment overwrites the original read diagnostic. The direct primary assertion fails before a secondary cleanup assertion.

items.name: collector-owned-close
items.staticTrace: The second output open fails before Popen. The first real output descriptor must close in source finally. Removing its close leaves exactly one output-kind stream open at the direct oracle; enclosing restoration has not run yet.

items.name: collector-terminal-attempt
items.staticTrace: The supplied read plus fsync failures still require a terminal record attempt. Omitting that call leaves no terminal event/file. The direct attempt oracle fails even though the local return would otherwise claim terminalRecorded=true.

items.name: record-primary-close
items.staticTrace: A write error precedes a supplied close error. Replacing cleanup append with primary assignment changes RecordFailure.primary to record-close. The direct primary type/reason/phase assertion fails with the exact chosen name.
